primary_endpoint: Construct at least one explicit strict norm-square cubic class outside the sixteen marked generic classes on MW16-05 at t=3/17, without exceptional-point inputs. Only after that endpoint, attempt transfer to a retained +10/+12 fibre.
input_whitelist: The cubic, field discriminant, S_finite and all sixteen generic_classes from rank_jump_prime_square_class_constructor_inputs_v1.json. Prime-ideal search choices and all oracle characters, exceptional coordinates and rank-derived class-group bounds are excluded from the arithmetic input projection.
method: One PARI bnfinit(nf,1) computation on the certified reference cubic. Preserve compact class/unit data on return. Obtain candidate virtual units from compact fundamental units and principal powers of even-order class generators, then impose every strict local square condition and prove independence modulo the generic subgroup. Incomplete class-group certification does not invalidate an independently checked individual ideal identity, but gives no completeness or upper-bound claim.
checkpointing: Exclusive input, setup, returned-BNF and terminal records; retain the debug log. Do not restart a live worker or increase the frozen limits. Further extraction has its own bounded stage after BNF returns.
failure_semantics: Timeout or stack exhaustion is UNKNOWN and no constructed class. A candidate is not called strict until its ideal, norm, all local conditions and independent nontriviality are certified. Rationality versus Sha is a separate unsolved endpoint unless certified.
boundary: Positive construction calibration only. No additional generic-capacity exclusions and no changes to active rank-search files or policies.
